messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up on the GQA/MQA selector RFC — we're seeing offline selector scores favor grouped-query, but in prod p95 latency regresses for short-chatty traces (seq < 64).

Maria: Saw the same in canary. Offline sims didn't capture the per-kernel setup overhead; grouped-query wins offline but tails get worse under low-token workloads.

Cheng: Replayed traces and reproduced. Our scoring currently models per-token cost linearly; with short sequences the handshake/setup amortization dominates.

Jordan: Do we have per-kernel-setup telemetry? Console traces only show aggregated per-token times afaik.

Alex: infra-bot: scheduled new trace tag `gqa_mqa.handshake_duration_ms` for dev traces over the next 48h :white_check_mark:

Maria: Short-term mitigation idea: add a handshake penalty to selector scoring. e.g.
`score = base_score - alpha * handshake_ms - beta * expected_per_token_cost`.

Cheng: Config sketch for experiments:
```
selector:
  weights:
    latency_weight: 1.0
    token_cost_weight: 0.7
    handshake_penalty_ms: 3.0
```
Tune per-hardware.

Jordan: Also think we should expose a `min_batch_size` / `min_collect_ms` hint to the runtime so grouped-query can wait 1-3ms to gather a tiny extra batch for short traces. That might reduce p95 without hurting avg latency.

Alex: Action items:
- Cheng: emit `gqa_mqa.handshake_duration_ms` and add to metrics pipeline (48h)
- Maria: implement selector penalty config and flip canary A/B to test today
- Jordan: prototype `min_collect_ms` hint in runtime, RFC follow-up

Maria: Add one more: update selector evaluation harness to include a short-seq slice (seq < 64) and replay recent short-chatty production traces so we don't miss regressions.

Cheng: Will run a sensitivity sweep across HW (A100, H100, T4) for `handshake_penalty_ms` and post numbers here.

Alex: If canary shows regressions, flip it back. I'll watch deploys and paging. Thanks all :thumbsup:
